name: Comet
author: E. T. Carter
description: A single comet on a long elliptical orbit inside a dark void: a bright nucleus with a tight coma and an ion tail that always streams anti-sunward, flaring long through the fast perihelion whip and shrinking to a stub on the slow aphelion crawl, with a faint dust trail decaying along the recently travelled arc.

params.label: Orbit period
params.effect: Seconds per full orbit; short values keep the perihelion whip coming, long values stretch the quiet aphelion crawl.

params.label: Eccentricity
params.effect: How stretched the ellipse is: low values give a rounder orbit with gentler pacing, high values an extreme dive-and-whip with a long slow far arc.

params.label: Tail length
params.effect: Ion-tail length at perihelion in CSS pixels, from a stubby smudge to a streak spanning much of the frame.

params.label: Dust trail
params.effect: Persistence of the dust trail along the orbit: 0 leaves no trace behind the nucleus, 1 keeps a faint glowing ghost of nearly the whole ellipse.
